entry.title: Sub-Quadratic Sparse Attention via Block-Spectral Routing at 1M Context. Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference.
entry.summary:
Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference. We propose Block-Spectral Routing (BSR), which projects key-value blocks onto a low-rank Chebyshev basis and routes queries to the top-$k$ spectral buckets in $O(L \log L)$ time, matching full FlashAttention-3 accuracy on needle-in-a-haystack and code reasoning benchmarks with $4.7\times$ lower KV-cache bandwidth.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #inference #ml-theory
